act_selection_rules.rule: pool filters: weak = RoomType.Monster && IsWeak; regular = RoomType.Monster && !IsWeak; elite = RoomType.Elite; boss = RoomType.Boss (all over GenerateAllEncounters order)
rooms per act = BaseNumberOfRooms (-1 in multiplayer); floors = rooms + 2

GenerateRooms(rng = RunRng.UpFront): events (act + shared, epoch-filtered) UnstableShuffle; normalEncounters = NumberOfWeakEncounters draws from a weak GrabBag, then draws from a regular GrabBag up to GetNumberOfRooms; eliteEncounters = 15 draws from an elite GrabBag; each bag refills (all weight 1.0) when empty; Boss = rng.NextItem(boss pool); Ancient = rng.NextItem(unlocked ancients ++ shared ancient subset)

AddWithoutRepeatingTags: GrabAndRemove with predicate 'shares no EncounterTag with the previous list entry and is not that entry'; rejection sampling (one draw per attempt); unconstrained GrabAndRemove when no element qualifies
ApplyDiscoveryOrderModifications (Standard mode, TestMode off): Boss := first BossDiscoveryOrder entry the profile has not seen; then the act's own first-run hook (Overgrowth only, NumberOfRuns == 0)
A10 DoubleBoss: last act gets SecondBoss = UpFront.NextItem(boss pool minus Boss)

map point counts (act GetMapPointTypes on the map Rng): rest-site count drawn first, then unknown-room count; NextGaussianInt(mean, stdDev, min, max) = Box-Muller on 2 NextDouble per attempt, Math.Round, retried until inside [min, max]; StandardRandomUnknownCount = NextGaussianInt(12, 1, 10, 14)
shared ancients: Darv subset handed to acts 2..n via UpFront.NextInt(count + 1) takes from an UnstableShuffle

room pulls: NextNormalEncounter = normalEncounters[visited % count] (the first NumberOfWeakEncounters monster rooms therefore get weak encounters); NextEliteEncounter likewise; NextBossEncounter returns SecondBoss once a boss was visited

act choice per index (StartRunLobby.BeginRunLocally): rng = Rng(GetDeterministicHashCode(seed) + GetDeterministicHashCode("act_selection")); for each ModelDb.ActsByIndex slot take the first unlocked non-default act not yet in Progress.DiscoveredActs (single player, TestMode off, profile-dependent), else rng.NextItem(unlocked acts of that slot); then act 0 := GetAct(lobby Act1), a no-op in v0.111.0 (the act dropdown is hidden, defaults to "random" and is copied into Act1 for single player and host; GetAct("random") is null); the same rng then resolves RandomCharacter picks
encounter Rng seed (v0.111.0) = (ulong)((long)RunRng.Seed + (long)TotalFloor) + GetDeterministicHashCode(Id.Entry); v0.107.1 used (uint)((int)Seed + TotalFloor + old hash)
enemy order: after each AddCreature with a SlotName, List.Sort by Slots.IndexOf(SlotName) (introsort; insertion sort below 17 elements is stable, unknown slots compare as -1)

event_combat_rules.rule: events with LayoutType Combat (PunchOff, TheLanternKey, TheArchitect) build their CanonicalEncounter at event entry, after BeginEvent: GenerateMonstersWithSlots (encounter Rng), new CombatState, AddPlayer, then CreateCreature + AddCreature per monster (one RunRng.Niche HP draw each); entering combat later reuses that CombatState (ShouldCreateCombat false)
other event combats (BattlewornDummy, DenseVegetation, FakeMerchant) create the CombatState only when EnterCombatWithoutExitingEvent fires (CreateCombatState(canonicalEncounter.ToMutable()))
TheArchitect never calls EnterCombatWithoutExitingEvent: its Architect creature is display-only (animations only)
